title: Health Atlas Research Suite
description: A source-backed map from whole-person outcomes through biology, context, measurement, intervention, and governance.
safetyNotice: BioAssist organizes observations, evidence, research, and measurement plans. It does not diagnose, prescribe, or authorize experimental devices for human use.

principles.title: Profile, not one score
principles.description: Show domain state, trajectory, confidence, and trade-offs instead of hiding them in a universal health score.

principles.title: State is not signal
principles.description: Keep latent health state separate from noisy observations, device outputs, and algorithmic inferences.

principles.title: Provenance is part of the value
principles.description: Retain source, time, method, units, context, quality, uncertainty, and transformation lineage.

principles.title: Measure for a decision
principles.description: Collect a signal only when its intended use, reference, interpretation boundary, and next action are explicit.

principles.title: Reassemble the whole person
principles.description: Connect biology to symptoms, function, goals, exposures, care burden, environment, and life course.

pipeline.label: Collect
pipeline.description: Documents, self-report, clinical data, devices, environment, and research instruments.

pipeline.label: Validate
pipeline.description: Identity, consent, calibration, artifacts, completeness, units, timing, and reference checks.

pipeline.label: Normalize
pipeline.description: Canonical concepts, units, temporal semantics, missingness reasons, and terminology mappings.

pipeline.label: Connect
pipeline.description: Attach observations to the fifteen branches, nine axes, episodes, goals, and causal relationships.

pipeline.label: Interpret
pipeline.description: Separate within-person change, population abnormality, clinical importance, diagnostic pattern, and causal inference.

pipeline.label: Act
pipeline.description: Present evidence, alternatives, risks, burden, decision owner, and escalation boundary.

pipeline.label: Re-measure
pipeline.description: Evaluate response, harm, adherence, function, uncertainty, and whether the decision changed.

axes.label: Scale or level
axes.prompt: At what level, from molecule to ecosystem?

axes.label: Mechanism or process
axes.prompt: How might it arise or propagate?

axes.label: Time and life course
axes.prompt: What is the onset, course, recurrence, and life-stage context?

axes.label: Determinants and exposures
axes.prompt: Which susceptibilities, resources, behaviors, and environments matter?

axes.label: Function and lived outcome
axes.prompt: What changes in symptoms, capacity, participation, quality of life, or survival?

axes.label: Context and population
axes.prompt: For whom, where, and under which conditions?

axes.label: Measurement and evidence
axes.prompt: How was it observed, with what quality, reference, and uncertainty?

axes.label: Intervention and governance
axes.prompt: What can change it, who decides, and who is accountable?

profileLayers.label: Identity and context
profileLayers.description: Relevant demographics, language, accessibility, relationships, occupation, geography, and consent.

profileLayers.label: Whole-person state
profileLayers.description: Symptoms, function, participation, well-being, safety, vital risk, and goals.

profileLayers.label: Physiological and biological state
profileLayers.description: Organ systems, laboratory values, imaging, waveforms, molecular, and genetic data.

profileLayers.label: Mechanisms and causal graph
profileLayers.description: Known and hypothesized pathways with confidence and competing explanations.

profileLayers.label: Life-course and exposure timeline
profileLayers.description: Development, reproduction, infection, injury, behavior, work, environment, and treatment.

profileLayers.label: Intervention and medication graph
profileLayers.description: What is being done, why, adherence, response, burden, interaction, and harm.

profileLayers.label: Care-system map
profileLayers.description: Responsible people, transitions, appointments, resources, barriers, and escalation.

profileLayers.label: Uncertainty and next information
profileLayers.description: Unresolved questions and measurements most likely to change a decision.

branchGroups.label: Whole-person outcomes
branchGroups.description: The state and goals the rest of the system should explain and improve.

branchGroups.label: Biological and clinical
branchGroups.description: Foundations, organ systems, cross-system processes, and host biology.

branchGroups.label: Mind, development, and experience
branchGroups.description: Cognition, behavior, relationships, function, development, and participation.

branchGroups.label: Context and population
branchGroups.description: Environment, population patterns, prevention, and public health.

branchGroups.label: Knowledge and action systems
branchGroups.description: Care delivery, data, evidence, interventions, rights, and governance.

branches.label: Whole-person health states and outcomes
branches.summary: Integrates risk, symptoms, function, participation, well-being, resilience, safety, care burden, and person-defined goals.

branches.label: Biological foundations and regulation
branches.summary: Connects molecular, genetic, cellular, tissue, signaling, metabolic, repair, and aging processes without treating omics as causality.

branches.label: Organ-system health
branches.summary: Fifteen deep packets connect organ physiology, disorders, clinical assessment, devices, engineering, intervention, and research roadmaps.

branches.label: Cross-system pathological processes
branches.summary: Provides primary homes for inflammation, thrombosis, ischemia, fibrosis, cancer, toxicity, edema, degeneration, injury, and iatrogenic harm.

branches.label: Brain, cognition, emotion, and behavior
branches.summary: Covers consciousness, perception, cognition, emotion, motivation, behavior, sleep, neurodevelopment, psychiatric spectra, and cognitive aging.

branches.label: Psychosocial, relational, cultural, and existential health
branches.summary: Represents relationships, loneliness, safety, roles, material conditions, culture, discrimination, displacement, digital life, meaning, and values.

branches.label: Development, reproduction, aging, and the life course
branches.summary: Links preconception, development, adulthood, reproductive transitions, aging, death, grief, and intergenerational effects.

branches.label: Infection, immunity, host-microbe biology, and biosecurity
branches.summary: Connects host defense, microbial ecology, infection, transmission, vaccination, antimicrobial resistance, outbreaks, and immune-mediated disease.

branches.label: Environmental, occupational, One Health, and planetary health
branches.summary: Represents physical, chemical, biological, built, occupational, climate, ecosystem, animal, food, water, and planetary determinants.

branches.label: Function, disability, rehabilitation, and participation
branches.summary: Connects impairment to capacity, activity, participation, environment, assistive technology, rehabilitation, and rights.

branches.label: Population health, prevention, and public health
branches.summary: Covers population distributions, surveillance, prevention, screening, community health, preparedness, burden, and inequity.

branches.label: Health care, professions, and delivery systems
branches.summary: Represents care settings, professions, coordination, continuity, safety, access, quality, workload, and financing.

branches.label: Measurement, evidence, data, and informatics
branches.summary: Holds metrology, evidence, uncertainty, provenance, interoperability, algorithms, data quality, causal inference, and knowledge representation.

branches.label: Interventions and therapeutics
branches.summary: Connects prevention, medication, procedures, devices, behavior, rehabilitation, environment, policy, palliation, and implementation.

branches.label: Ethics, law, rights, equity, and governance
branches.summary: Makes consent, privacy, access, fairness, rights, accountability, contestability, resource allocation, and public trust visible.

Atlas_of_Human_Health_Unified_Taxonomy_2.title: Atlas of Human Health: Unified Taxonomy
Atlas_of_Human_Health_Unified_Taxonomy_2.summary: Defines the fifteen branches, nine axes, health-coordinate record, integrated profile, dataset entities, device taxonomy, and implementation roadmap.

01_Whole_Person_Health_States_and_Outcom.title: Whole-Person Health States and Outcomes
01_Whole_Person_Health_States_and_Outcom.summary: Defines the outcomes every other domain should explain: risk, burden, symptoms, function, participation, well-being, resilience, and goals.

02_Biological_Foundations_and_Regulation.title: Biological Foundations and Regulation
02_Biological_Foundations_and_Regulation.summary: Maps nested adaptive biology from sequence and regulation through cells, tissues, signaling, energy, repair, and aging.

Cardiovascular_Health_and_Measurement_En.title: Cardiovascular Health and Measurement Engineering
Cardiovascular_Health_and_Measurement_En.summary: Connects cardiovascular causes, prevention, devices, signal chains, engineering controls, data architecture, and a staged research platform.

03B_Respiratory_Health_and_Measurement_E.title: Respiratory Health and Measurement Engineering
03B_Respiratory_Health_and_Measurement_E.summary: Covers ventilation, gas exchange, defense, pulmonary circulation, sleep, exercise reserve, devices, and safe respiratory engineering.

03C_Nervous_System_Health_and_Neurotechn.title: Nervous System Health and Neurotechnology
03C_Nervous_System_Health_and_Neurotechn.summary: Links neural structure, electrophysiology, circulation, cognition, behavior, function, stimulation, and neurotechnology governance.

03D_Endocrine_and_Metabolic_Health.pdf.title: Endocrine and Metabolic Health
03D_Endocrine_and_Metabolic_Health.pdf.summary: Treats hormones and metabolism as coupled feedback, flux, timing, reserve, laboratory, sensor, and closed-loop control systems.

03E_Gastrointestinal_Hepatobiliary_and_P.title: Gastrointestinal, Hepatobiliary, and Pancreatic Health
03E_Gastrointestinal_Hepatobiliary_and_P.summary: Integrates digestive physiology, liver and pancreatic function, nutrition, microbiology, symptoms, imaging, endoscopy, and ingestible devices.

03F_Renal_and_Urinary_Health.pdf.title: Renal and Urinary Health
03F_Renal_and_Urinary_Health.pdf.summary: Separates filtration, injury, tubular function, volume, electrolytes, urinary function, reserve, dialysis, and cardiorenal-metabolic coupling.

03G_Hematologic_Health_and_Hemostasis.pd.title: Hematologic Health and Hemostasis
03G_Hematologic_Health_and_Hemostasis.pd.summary: Integrates blood-cell production and function, oxygen transport, hemostasis, thrombosis, rheology, clonal evolution, transfusion, and assay engineering.

03H_Immune_and_Lymphatic_Health.pdf.title: Immune and Lymphatic Health
03H_Immune_and_Lymphatic_Health.pdf.summary: Models immune health as regulated defense, tolerance, repair, transport, memory, and resolution rather than a strong-versus-weak score.

03I_Musculoskeletal_and_Connective_Tissu.title: Musculoskeletal and Connective-Tissue Health
03I_Musculoskeletal_and_Connective_Tissu.summary: Connects tissue biology and mechanics to pain, movement, function, participation, load, rehabilitation, and assistive-device design.

03J_Integumentary_and_Dermatologic_Healt.title: Integumentary and Dermatologic Health
03J_Integumentary_and_Dermatologic_Healt.summary: Integrates barrier, immunity, circulation, sensation, appearance, wound repair, imaging quality, skin-tone bias, and device safety.

03K_Sensory_Health_and_Measurement.pdf.title: Sensory Health and Measurement
03K_Sensory_Health_and_Measurement.pdf.summary: Connects physical stimuli, sensory organs, neural coding, perception, adaptation, real-world function, and assistive technology.

03L_Oral_Dental_and_Craniofacial_Health..title: Oral, Dental, and Craniofacial Health
03L_Oral_Dental_and_Craniofacial_Health..summary: Treats oral health as integral to nutrition, pain, infection, communication, airway, appearance, systemic health, and access.
initiatives: Low-cost optical caries and lesion platform

03M_Reproductive_and_Sexual_Health.pdf.title: Reproductive and Sexual Health
03M_Reproductive_and_Sexual_Health.pdf.summary: Integrates fertility, contraception, sexual function and well-being, infection, pelvic health, autonomy, relationships, and access.

03N_Maternal_Fetal_and_Perinatal_Health..title: Maternal, Fetal, and Perinatal Health
03N_Maternal_Fetal_and_Perinatal_Health..summary: Models pregnancy as a coupled maternal-placental-fetal system through preconception, gestation, birth, postpartum, and neonatal transition.

03O_Integrated_Homeostatic_Systems.pdf.title: Integrated Homeostatic Systems
03O_Integrated_Homeostatic_Systems.pdf.summary: Explains cross-organ stability, adaptive regulation, reserve under challenge, decompensation, and recovery rather than static normality.

04_Cross_System_Pathological_Processes.p.title: Cross-System Pathological Processes
04_Cross_System_Pathological_Processes.p.summary: Organizes mechanisms that cross specialty boundaries by causal process, temporal phase, organ distribution, and functional outcome.

programs.title: Atlas knowledge registry
programs.summary: Version the sources, branches, axes, measurement families, gaps, and build targets as queryable data.

programs.title: Longitudinal observation envelope
programs.summary: Create the append-only event contract for clinical, document, device, self-report, and environment observations.

programs.title: Cardiovascular research pilot
programs.summary: Use cardiovascular health as the first deep domain to validate registry, device, protocol, profile, and dataset contracts.

programs.title: Safe reference acquisition stack
programs.summary: Begin with synchronized, battery-powered raw ECG, PPG, IMU, and temperature plus a validated external cuff and simulator-first testing.

programs.title: Quality and provenance engine
programs.summary: Make artifact, calibration, reference, missingness, transformation, algorithm version, and uncertainty first-class data.

programs.title: Multi-axial profile graph
programs.summary: Connect observations, concepts, mechanisms, function, goals, interventions, and care context without flattening uncertainty.

programs.title: Narrow validated claims
programs.summary: Advance one intended use at a time from bench verification through analytical validity, clinical validity, utility, and surveillance.

programs.title: Consent, claims, and governance ledger
programs.summary: Bind every use and user-facing health claim to permitted purpose, evidence, version, review status, and accountability.
